manifest_authentication.anchor_source: the trusted root bootstrap supplies the expected manifest SHA-256 outside the manifest
order: reject invalid UTF-8 and duplicate object members
manifest_authentication.failure: reject before a runtime generation or executable Blob URL exists

accepted_bounds_contract.binding: all 24 accepted bound IDs are bound by p0-runtime-manifest.schema.json; pre-decode, UTF-8 byte, aggregate, equality, and observed-byte rules remain mandatory when JSON Schema cannot express them

boot_inputs.write_policy: release is populated before entry, then write/create/rename/unlink/truncate/directory-mutation/link/device operations are denied

module_policy.authorization: exact name plus digest, single use
module_policy.closure_action: atomically consume exact authorization and close every further admission path before native parsing
module_policy.on_load: deny unless exact module and native edges are separately manifest-qualified

runtime_identity.mismatch_action: cancel and terminate generation before ready

generation_ownership.token: fresh supervisor-generated unforgeable 256-bit runtime-generation token, stored outside the immutable manifest and bound in the registry to its computed manifest digest
generation_ownership.cleanup: idempotent cancellation, revoke authority, terminate every Worker, cancel handles, revoke Blob URLs, reject pending promises, sample quiescence

failure_matrix.detect: exact response-byte SHA-256 differs from the bootstrap-pinned digest
failure_matrix.action: reject before decode or generation creation with no fallback

failure_matrix.detect: invalid UTF-8, duplicate object member, excessive depth/records, or schema failure during bounded decode

failure_matrix.action: reject, count, and perform no effect

failure_matrix.detect: source, build, artifact, runtime, or module digest mismatch
any of the 24 accepted Phase 2 bounds, including overflow-checked aggregate or observed-byte checks, is breached
failure_matrix.action: reject before allocation where specified and terminate if generation exists

failure_matrix.detect: entry count, member bytes, aggregate expanded bytes, path, or indexed member digest breaches the accepted release rules
failure_matrix.action: abort expansion, discard the partial mount, and terminate the generation

failure_matrix.detect: memory is not page-aligned, exceeds the accepted ceiling, or initial and maximum differ
the POC manifest declares any host capability
verified single-file Worker output attempts an import, importScripts, child Worker, or other undeclared executable fetch
failure_matrix.action: terminate the complete generation and retain the emitted-output failure
terminate all registered agents and revoke handles

p3_boundary: P3 stops at booted-for-qualification; P4 alone consumes the one-shot qualification authorization and may reach ready
